nodes.label: Creative North Star: The Patient Tutor's Paper
nodes.rationale: The surface a patient one-on-one tutor works on: a clean clinical sheet (pure-white #ffffff base, neutral-gray #f5f5f5 working surfaces, dark ink) matching the host-site palette so the sim reads as one seamless page. Patience lives in the voice, pacing and quiet chrome, not tint; saturated colour is rationed to two jobs only - the functional engineering encodings and the one blue accent. Rewritten 2026-07-09, retiring the former warm off-white drafting-paper framing.

nodes.label: Clinical / Inverted Palette and token table
nodes.rationale: The live CSS custom-property colour system (paper #ffffff, panel #f5f5f5, solid-fill #e7e1d4, ink #221f18, accent #1f66b5, hp-line teal #007f7c, vp-line amber #bc5d1e, pp-line violet #7a5ea6, success #2e7d52, plus Module-1 construction-aid tokens). Authored in OKLCH for intent, stored as resolved sRGB hex because THREE.Color cannot parse oklch(). Paper/panel tones were swapped and content surfaces returned to white in the 2026-07-09 clinical-palette phase.

nodes.label: The Quiet Chrome Rule
nodes.rationale: The blue accent covers at most ~10% of any screen; if more than a tenth of the chrome is blue it is overused. The eye must land on the viewport, not the UI.

nodes.label: The Chrome-Only Blue Rule
nodes.rationale: Blue belongs to the guidance layer (steps, actions, focus) and never appears as a domain colour inside the viewport, which uses the functional encodings (HP teal, VP amber). This separation lets a learner tell 'the UI is guiding me' from 'this is the domain content' even on a washed-out projector.

nodes.label: The Two-Cue Rule
nodes.rationale: No colour carries meaning alone; every functional encoding pairs its hue with a second cue - line weight, dash pattern, label, icon, arrow, or shape. HP is teal + solid + 'HP' label; VP amber + dashed + 'VP'; PP violet + label + position; Success green + check; Disabled faint + reduced opacity + lock icon. CVD-safe.

nodes.label: The Two-Weight Rule
nodes.rationale: Atkinson Hyperlegible ships Regular (400) and Bold (700) only. Build hierarchy from size and the 700 bold, never from a 500/600 weight that does not exist (and never synthesize bold).

nodes.label: The Tabular Rule
nodes.rationale: Every value the math depends on is set in IBM Plex Mono with font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums so it does not shift width as it updates. Showing real values in real units is the line between an engineering instrument and a toy.

nodes.label: The Flat-Ink Rule
nodes.rationale: Surfaces are flat at rest; depth is tonal layering (paper -> panel -> solid-fill) and 1px hairlines, not shadows. Rendered geometry never casts a shadow; a shadow is only legitimate lifting a transient floating overlay off the page.

nodes.label: The Border-Over-Shadow Rule
nodes.rationale: Structure comes from a single crisp 1px hairline (#d9d2c3) and tonal layering, not a drop shadow. Cards and panels are separated by tone and seam, not by float.

nodes.label: The Host-Integration White Exception (retired 2026-07-09)
nodes.rationale: Under the clinical palette the separate --color-host-white token is gone from the code. Former consumers split by role: content surfaces (step card, #active-problem, .problem-card, .problem-library, .compare-card frame) sit on paper #ffffff, while chrome chips (wizard toggle, quick-views, .vp-hint/spotlights) sit on the neutral-gray panel #f5f5f5 shell. Token discipline unchanged: never a bare #fff/#000 literal.

nodes.label: The z-index ladder
nodes.rationale: A single ordered ladder of tokens so transient layers never fight: --z-term 60, --z-compare 90, --z-notice 100, --z-overlay 120, --z-toast 130, --z-restoring 150, --z-boot 200 (full ladder in Module1/src/shell.css). Never hard-code a z-index. Module 2 defines only the two rungs it needs (--z-notice, --z-overlay).

nodes.label: The no-transform invariant (Module 1)
nodes.rationale: #sim-viewport, #canvas-area and body must stay transform-free. Module 1's Compare card floats its #c2d canvas position:fixed from measured viewport rects; a CSS transform on any ancestor would establish a containing block and break that placement.

nodes.label: Wizard layout - the right-hand column
nodes.rationale: The guided stepper is a fixed-width vertical column pinned right (width clamp(340px,34vw,460px)) beside the flexible left 3D viewport, separated by a 1px border-left. Strict background mandate: viewport is --color-paper #ffffff, wizard panel is --color-panel #f5f5f5, never swapped. Module 1 additionally carries the .brand wordmark and .chapnav switcher (Module-1-specific).

nodes.label: Step rail (signature component)
nodes.rationale: A vertical numbered spine: Completed = Success-green disc + check glyph, Current = filled accent disc + soft halo + bold label, Upcoming = hollow faint disc. Shape + number carries state without relying on colour; a live region announces 'Step X of N'. Learners may revisit any step up to maxReached.

nodes.label: Inline term definition (signature component)
nodes.rationale: First appearance of engineering vocabulary (HP, VP, orthographic projection, ground line) is a dotted-underline accent button that reveals a small accent-wash popover (#e3ecf7) defining the term in plain language; exposed to screen readers via aria-describedby. position:fixed to escape the card scroll clip, flips above when no room, dismisses on Escape.

nodes.label: Motion palette and press conventions
nodes.rationale: CSS keyframes plus a rAF tween system (anim.js) with a no-overshoot named easing palette (easeStandard, easeFold, easeCamera, easeDraw, easeDissolve); everything collapses to instant under prefers-reduced-motion. Base tokens --dur-fast 150ms, --dur-base 200ms, --dur-step 380ms, --ease-standard cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1). Every pressable control shares the scale(0.97) press; auto-zoom dolly is 500ms/easeStandard.

nodes.label: Scrollbars - the floating padded pill
nodes.rationale: Scroll containers show a floating padded scrollbar pill (10px WebKit channel, 3px transparent border + background-clip:padding-box so ~4px paints), tinted --color-border, border-radius 999px, transparent track. Load-bearing gotcha: leave scrollbar-width UNSET on the base rule (set only inside a Firefox @supports guard) or Chrome 121+ disables the ::-webkit-scrollbar pseudo-elements.

nodes.label: Typography - Atkinson Hyperlegible + IBM Plex Mono
nodes.rationale: Body/UI font is Atkinson Hyperlegible; numeric font is IBM Plex Mono; these are the only fonts, bundled as subset woff2 via @font-face (Atkinson 400/700, Plex Mono 400), no external font CDN. Roles: Title/Lead/Body/Label in Atkinson, every live numeric Value plus the mono 'Step X of N' eyebrow in Plex Mono.
